name: Realization of the PLTS-2000 with a 3He melting-pressure thermometer on a dilution-refrigerator platform, normalized at the 315.24 mK pressure minimum
plain_name: Set the millikelvin temperature scale from the pressure at which helium-3 freezes
description: A capacitive 3He melting-pressure cell is bolted to the refrigerator platform and read with a three-terminal capacitance bridge. A nuclear stage is needed to reach the Néel point at 0.902 mK.
keywords: Set the millikelvin temperature scale from the pressure at which helium-3 freezes

sources.citation: BIPM CCT Supplementary Information for the Realization of the PLTS-2000

reported_equipment: 3He melting-pressure cells of Greywall and Busch (1982)
Schuster, Hoffmann and Hechtfischer (2001) melting-pressure thermometer on a dilution refrigerator

requirements.rationale: The scale must pass through its pressure minimum at 315.24 mK.
The cell is operated from about 1 K down through the minimum.
Three-terminal capacitor readout needs one coax line per plate.
Covering the full scale down to 0.902 mK needs a nuclear cooling stage.
